changelog: Company money now lives in your framework's society accounts (esx_addonaccount, Renewed-Banking, qb-banking or qb-management), so money paid in by billing, fines and shops shows in the Work Tablet.
Every balance change is recorded in a ledger, and every management action (hires, firings, promotions, grade edits, payments) in an audit log.

Everything players read can be translated: the Work Tablet, City Services, the Job Portal, ID cards and every notification. Copy `locales/en.lua` to your language, translate it and set `Config.Locale`; anything you leave out stays English.
Developer API v1: `docs/API.md` documents every export and event, and `GetApiVersion` returns the version.
Console commands `cityhub_doctor` (money provider and balances) and `cityhub_audit <job>` (latest actions).
Managers can now only hire, promote, demote, fire or pay members below their own grade. Set `ServerConfig.Management.strictRanks = false` for the 1.1 behaviour.
Resigning from the tablet now notifies managers and is audited.
Removed the unused `bhuvi_cityhub:mdt:*` callbacks, the `PaginatedQuery` export and `ServerConfig.MDT`.
Saving grades no longer replaces the Work Tablet with "Slow down a little".
The Employees tab no longer offers Fire or grade changes the server refuses.
Errors the server returns that have no translation now show a general message instead of a raw code.
Deposits and withdrawals over the limit now say what the limit is instead of "Invalid amount".
A society balance change that failed to save is retried instead of only being logged.
New tables are created automatically and every new option has a safe default.
